caption: Figure 9.4 E. coli cloning vector pBR322 showing restriction sites (Hind III, EcoR I, BamH I, Sal I, Pvu II, Pst I, Cla I), ori and antibiotic resistance genes (amp^R and tet^R). rop codes for the proteins involved in the replication of the plasmid.
note: 'amp^R' and 'tet^R' carry a printed superscript capital R, both on the map and in the caption. In the caption the enzyme-name stems are italicised (E. coli, Hind, Eco, Bam, Sal, Pvu, Pst, Cla); italics are not representable here so plain text is given. Crop over-includes a clipped body-text line at the top ('...ells do not carry resistance'), two clipped lines at the bottom ('...nts growing on ampicillin' / '...d on a medium containing') and the orange page number '169'; all excluded. Watermark ignored.
